name: lfk-multiline-log-event-assembly
instr:
lfk's Log Top cannot yet handle multiline application output as bounded logical events. Make detection, parsing, aggregation, timestamps, and displayed accounting agree while preserving ordinary single-line behavior.

Have every built-in parser classify each physical line deterministically through `Parser.Boundary`. Generic JSON must assemble incomplete objects but reject complete malformed JSON without consuming the next record. Traefik JSON must also require its access-log keys. Logfmt may join recognized continuation text but not a new key-value record. Nginx combined, ingress-nginx, and Envoy must keep their strict ownership; ingress-nginx still requires its specific tail. Unrelated console or stack-trace text stays independent, and no continuation creates an event without a valid start.

`LineAssembler` must emit complete parseable events once, in order, using first-line metadata. Bounds and final flushes force pending content exactly once. Detection and parsing must use the same assembled events; disabled multiline detection samples physical lines. Live ingestion, buffered replay, redetection, profile changes, and restored tabs must produce identical events and counters. Completion or cancellation flushes before final physical, logical, pending, and forced counts become visible.

Keep existing rows, metrics, preferences, timestamps, sorting, filtering, hidden columns, and adaptive layout while showing logical versus physical counts and pending or forced status. Pretty-p
